server.description: Hecher CRM for Chabad shluchim — donors, donations, activities, and reports across your Mosads
server.title: Hecher CRM

tools.description: List the organizations (Mosads) you have access to.
tools.name: list_tenants

tools.description: Choose which Mosad subsequent calls operate on.
tools.name: set_active_tenant

tools.description: Show the currently active Mosad.
tools.name: get_active_tenant

tools.description: Search donors by name, email, phone, tag, or status.
tools.name: search_donors

tools.description: Fetch a donor's full profile, including stats and contact info.
tools.name: get_donor

tools.description: Create a new donor record.
tools.name: create_donor

tools.description: Update an existing donor record.
tools.name: update_donor

tools.description: Soft-delete a donor record.
tools.name: delete_donor

tools.description: Add a tag to a single donor.
tools.name: add_donor_tag

tools.description: Remove a tag from a single donor.
tools.name: remove_donor_tag

tools.description: Add a tag to many donors at once (queued).
tools.name: bulk_tag_donors

tools.description: List donations, optionally filtered by donor or date.
tools.name: list_donations

tools.description: Record a new donation.
tools.name: create_donation

tools.description: Update an existing donation.
tools.name: update_donation

tools.description: Delete a donation.
tools.name: delete_donation

tools.description: List activities/tasks, optionally filtered by donor, status, or assignee.
tools.name: list_activities

tools.description: Create a new activity (task, call, meeting, note).
tools.name: create_activity

tools.description: Mark an activity as complete.
tools.name: complete_activity

tools.description: Fetch dashboard KPIs for the active Mosad.
tools.name: get_dashboard_stats

tools.description: Execute a saved report and return results.
tools.name: run_report

documentation.setup: Add https://api.hecher.app/mcp as a remote MCP server in your client (Claude Desktop, ChatGPT, Cursor, etc.). On first use you'll be redirected to sign in to Hecher and approve access. Manage and revoke connections anytime under Settings → AI Connections.

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.permissions: Acts with the permissions of the signed-in user in whichever Mosad they pick as active. All RLS, billing gates, and audit logging from the Hecher API gateway apply.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.rateLimits: Inherits the per-user rate limits of the Hecher API gateway.
